description.value: The Telkwa Museum is a local history attraction in the small village of Telkwa, situated at the confluence of the Bulkley and Telkwa rivers along Highway 16 (the Yellowhead). The village sits on the traditional territory of the Gidim'ten Clan of the Witsuwit'en people, and the museum offers touring cyclists a chance to explore a piece of northwestern BC's history mid-route. It is operated in connection with the village's Reading Centre and promoted through the Village of Telkwa's municipal tourism pages.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is the Village of Telkwa's municipal site, which references the museum briefly: 'stop at the Telkwa Museum, 1620 Highway 16.' No cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched pages. The museum is also referred to on the site as 'Museum & Reading Centre,' differing slightly from the OSM name. OSM carries no phone or address, so those fields are taken from the website; the website URL matches the OSM-discovered URL.
concerns: OSM name is 'Telkwa Museum' but the Village website refers to it as 'Museum & Reading Centre' — the official name may differ.
Phone number (250-846-5212) is the Village municipal office number, not a direct museum line; it may not reach museum staff.
OSM community field is 'Unknown / North Coast & Haida Gwaii' but Telkwa is geographically in the Bulkley Valley — community classification may need correction.
No dedicated museum webpage exists; content is embedded in the Village's general tourism site with minimal detail about the museum itself.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The museum is a legitimate touring stop on Highway 16 but no cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) could be confirmed from available evidence. A direct museum-specific page or on-site verification is needed before a confident WWC include decision can be made.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Village of Telkwa municipal office at 1415 Hankin Ave (info@telkwa.ca, 250-846-5212) may be able to provide additional details about museum amenities on request.

wow_evidence: Small village museum at the Bulkley-Telkwa confluence; modest heritage stop.
blurb: Village history museum in Telkwa at the rivers' confluence.
